01-553
DIAGNOSTICS BODY CONTROL SYSTEM
Daytime Running Light No. 2 Relay Circuit
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
When the light control switch is set to OFF or TAIL after the following conditions are satisfied simultaneously
with the ignition switch ON, the daytime running lights up by control of the body ECU.
• The parking brake switch is OFF.
• The generator is ON (Engine running)
